_note: The campaign. Planets open when the number of missions cleared reaches opens_at. A mission opens with its planet once every mission it requires is cleared. Each mission gives one part on its first clear and another for meeting its plus challenge, which is shown only after the first clear. Coordinates in metres: start and mech at are [x, z, yaw_deg]; unit at is [x, z, altitude], and an altitude below zero means on top of whatever stands there.

planets.name: HALDEN
planets.blurb: An industrial world of foundries and freight yards, and home port. Its towers are lit all night.
planets.gimmick: Standard gravity. A good place to learn the frame.

missions.name: GUNSHIP SWEEP
missions.scene: Two contractor gunships are circling the freight avenue. Clear the sky over Halden.

missions.name: SHAKEDOWN RUN
missions.scene: Your old wingmate has built a course down the avenue: rings to thread, a tower to land on, a door only a switch will open. Friendly race, no weapons.

missions.name: HOLD THE YARDS
missions.scene: An invading column is rolling on the freight yards. If more than three depots fall, Halden's supply line goes with them.

missions.name: MIRROR MATCH
missions.scene: A rival contractor has copied your frame part for part. Prove the pilot matters.

missions.name: THE BREAKWATER
missions.scene: The contractor walled off Halden's south port: a rampart a hundred and eighty metres high, guns along its crest, one gate tunnel through it. Clear the approach, break through the gate, climb the inner face, and take the guardian on top.

stages.objective: Clear the approach to the wall
Climb the inner face to the top

planets.name: SERE
planets.blurb: A desert of red mesas under a sky full of sand. You will hear things before you see them.
planets.gimmick: Sandstorm: you see a few hundred metres at most.

missions.name: CONVOY BREAK
missions.scene: An armoured train is running the canyon south with stolen reactor cores. Break its four cars before it reaches the tunnel; land on its roof to keep pace. The engine opens when the cars are gone.

missions.name: GLASS NEST
missions.scene: Searchlights sweep the turret nest that closed the western pass. Slip in under the storm, scan its three caches, and get clear. If a light finds you, the nest wakes, and so does what sleeps under it.

missions.name: DUNE GAUNTLET
missions.scene: The canyon racers of Sere run a gauntlet: pistons that slam the canyon floor, a slalom of walls, a mesa stair to land your way up. One has challenged you.

missions.name: THE SCORPION
missions.scene: A routine job: survey drones have strayed over the southern pass. Shoot them down and come home.

stages.objective: AMBUSH — the Scorpion and its spotter

planets.name: SPINDLE
planets.blurb: A ring of a world that broke apart, rebuilt around its own wreckage and spun for gravity. The ground curves up overhead.
planets.gimmick: Ring gravity: you are thrown outward onto the inside of the ring. Run far enough sideways and you come back round.

missions.name: SPIN-UP
missions.scene: A coolant line has burst at the hub and the ring is shaking itself apart. Run a full turn of the Spindle to the dock before the sections behind you, and ahead of you, come down.

missions.name: COLD FLOW
missions.scene: The hub's coolant plant sits under a shield dome, and nothing you fire gets through. Four generators round the ring hold it up, and the Ring Hulk walks between them. Break the generators, then the plant.

missions.name: LONG WAY ROUND
missions.scene: The ring's couriers race a full turn of the Spindle on platforms that move. Land on the lifts, ride them up, and keep your head; the floor goes up.

missions.name: KEEPER OF THE SPINDLE
missions.scene: The ring's keeper flies close to the axis and calls down shells on wherever you are heading, while two wardens hunt you along the floor. Watch the ground: a ring of light is where the next one lands.

planets.name: RIME
planets.blurb: A pale moon of ice needles. Gravity is light and the ground gives no grip.
planets.gimmick: Low gravity and ice: jumps soar, and a frame slides into and out of every move.

missions.name: WHITEOUT
missions.scene: Gunships and turrets hold the ice plain. Clear it; mind your footing.

missions.name: SKATER
missions.scene: Rime's racers land on the needle tops in low gravity and thread the ice walls. Little grip, less margin.

missions.name: THAW LINE
missions.scene: Raiders want the relay pylons on the western shelf. Lose two and the moon goes silent.

missions.name: TWIN SHADOWS
missions.scene: Two light frames that fight as one. When one dodges, the other fires.

planets.name: CINDER
planets.blurb: A world of basalt columns standing in lava. The air is ash; the ground is death.
planets.gimmick: The floor burns: every second on the bare ground costs AP. Stay on the columns or in the air.

missions.name: ASHFALL
missions.scene: The lava is rising through the column field, and turrets on the tallest columns are shelling the evacuation. Silence them before it reaches you; climb as it climbs.

missions.name: EMBER RUN
missions.scene: Column to column over the lava, up a rising lift, under the pistons and through a vault only a switch opens. Touch the lava and it will cost you more than time.

missions.name: LAST FOUNDRY
missions.scene: The contractor has taken Cinder's last foundry to build frames against us. Go inside: break its three reactors, stay out of the lights, and get out by the south vent. An alarm seals the door you came in by.

stages.objective: Get out by the south vent

missions.name: IRON VECTOR
missions.scene: The contractor's ace, in the best frame money can buy, with two gunships at its shoulders. Its pulse armour turns every hit until it breaks; then you have seconds before it is whole again. This is the job.

planets.name: TETHYS
planets.blurb: A dead sea of black glass that no chart shows. The things that walk here were built for wars between worlds: frames the size of towers, and fortresses the size of cities.
planets.gimmick: Arms forts: past the first giants, each target is a walking fortress. Land on it, break its weak points, and the core opens.

missions.name: FIRST GIANT
missions.scene: A frame ten times your height walks the glass, armed like any frame. Find out what it can take.

missions.name: TWIN COLOSSI
missions.scene: Two frames thirty times your height, each with guns riding its shoulders. They walk together.

missions.name: WALKING BASTION
missions.scene: An arms fort seven hundred metres long, on four legs. Climb its legs, break the joints, and the core on its tower opens.

missions.name: LEVIATHAN
missions.scene: Two kilometres of fortress on six legs, with engines astern and guns end to end.

missions.name: THE ARK
missions.scene: Seven kilometres long and taller than any mountain on Halden, with escorts at its feet. Whoever built it is not coming back for it.
